title: The Two-Ledger Model: Transaction-Grain Cost Accounting for Multi-Agent AI Systems Across Clouds, Models, and Systems of Record
abstract: arXiv:2611.06989v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprises run business transactions through multi-agent AI systems spanning clouds, large language models (LLMs), orchestration harnesses, and systems of record. Finance receives AI cost only at settlement grain, aggregated by SKU and charge period. The business question (what did this order, claim, or case cost in AI?) cannot be answered from billing data, because providers never see enterprise transaction boundaries. The FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification (FOCUS) gives billing data one schema across providers but remains settlement-grain even as it adds AI token and requester attribution. We formalize this grain mismatch, derive seven requirements, and propose the Two-Ledger Model: a settlement ledger of FOCUS-conformant billing data joined to an attribution ledger of invocation-grain usage records built on OpenTelemetry GenAI telemetry. translated_title: 双账本模型：跨云、跨模型与记录系统的多智能体AI系统事务粒度成本核算
translated_abstract: 企业通过跨越云平台、大语言模型（LLM）、编排框架和记录系统的多智能体AI系统来运行业务事务。财务部门只能以结算粒度接收AI成本数据，并按SKU和计费周期进行汇总。“这笔订单、理赔或案例究竟花费了多少AI成本？”这一业务问题无法从账单数据中得到解答，因为服务提供商永远无法看到企业的事务边界。FinOps开放成本与使用规范（FOCUS）为账单数据提供了跨提供商的统一模式，但即使新增了AI令牌和请求者归因功能，其粒度仍停留在结算粒度。我们形式化了这种粒度不匹配问题，推导出七项需求，并提出双账本模型：一个由符合FOCUS规范的账单数据构成的结算账本，与一个基于OpenTelemetry GenAI遥测构建的、包含调用粒度使用记录的归因账本相连接。通过分层关联主干（追踪上下文、A2A/MCP元数据、业务键关联等）……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“双账本模型”，通过将符合FOCUS规范的结算级账单数据与基于OpenTelemetry GenAI遥测构建的调用粒度归因账本相连接，解决了多智能体AI系统中结算粒度账单与业务事务粒度成本核算之间的粒度不匹配问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Two-Ledger Model, which resolves the grain mismatch between settlement-level billing data and transaction-level cost accounting in multi-agent AI systems by joining a FOCUS-conformant settlement ledger with an attribution ledger of invocation-grain usage records built on OpenTelemetry GenAI telemetry.
